mapper.sql: comment_id, delete_root_id, note_id, level, parent_id, content_uuid, is_content_empty, create_time, content_cleanup_status, deleted_time
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_comment_tombstone WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
SELECT FROM t_comment_tombstone WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_comment_tombstone (comment_id, delete_root_id, note_id, level, parent_id, content_uuid, is_content_empty, create_time, content_cleanup_status, deleted_time) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{deleteRootId}, #{noteId}, #{level}, #{parentId}, #{contentUuid}, #{contentEmpty}, #{createTime}, IF(#{contentEmpty} = b'1' OR #{contentUuid} IS NULL OR #{contentUuid} = '', 'CLEANED', 'PENDING'), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE comment_id = comment_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_comment_tombstone t WHERE t.content_cleanup_status = 'PENDING' AND t.is_content_empty = b'0' AND t.content_uuid IS NOT NULL AND t.content_uuid != '' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_comment_inbox i WHERE i.event_key = CONCAT('comment-delete:', t.delete_root_id) AND i.event_type = 'DELETE' AND i.status = 'APPLIED' ) ORDER BY t.comment_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_comment_tombstone SET content_cleanup_status = 'CLEANED' WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND content_cleanup_status = 'PENDING'
